0022600034.text: The Pacers host the Knicks in Indiana's 13th game of the season, and Indiana enters at 3-8, 12th in the East and 4.5 games behind in the Central, having lost two straight and gone 0-5 at home. New York is 6-4, fourth in the East and 2.5 games back in the Atlantic, riding a four-game winning streak. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Pacers lost their 2025-26 series 1-3, including a 136-110 defeat in New York on March 17. Indiana will be without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain, 21.8 points per game this season), Ben Sheppard (knee) and Johnny Furphy (knee surgery).
